1	"""FinalAgent: bargains in SUPPLIER-VALUE space with lever bundles, not on unit price.
2	
3	Why: the supplier prices every sheet by what it is worth to it in cash (price at its standard terms, minus
4	the cost of the payment days we ask), and terms such as contract months, lead time or an index clause are
5	free for it. So we (1) fix the VALUE we offer each round, (2) pick the lever combination that is cheapest
6	for US at that value (long payment, short lead time, ...), and set the price that gives exactly that value.
7	- Value schedule: anchor at 0.76 x the value of their sheet, then close 55% of the gap, then jump to the
8	  fixed point of "their ask falls by g x our rise" (g estimated, default 0.25): the ask freezes at a random
9	  early round, so two big moves beat ten small steps. A sheet above their value x (1 - tol) is accepted at
10	  our price, so we only go above it in the message at moves_left == 2 (A - tick); at moves_left <= 1 we close.
11	- Sheets: the lowest-C bundle, the lowest-C bundle with payment <= their standard (suppliers that refuse
12	  long terms), their own terms re-priced (pure price move). Cheapest for us first: they take the first of equal value.
13	- Closing: a supplier sheet meets us when its C is no more than our cheapest sheet's C.
14	- A silent thread is skipped after `max_asks` messages; never walk away while a supplier is alive.
15	"""

18	import math

123	    levers = [f for f in case["negotiable"] if f != "unit_price"]

136	    for vals in itertools.product(*options):
137	        combo = satisfy_must_haves(case, dict(zip(levers, vals, strict=True)), std_full)
138	        v0 = _value(case, std_full, {**combo, "unit_price": 0.0})
139	        b = _value(case, std_full, {**combo, "unit_price": 1.0}) - v0
140	        if b > 0:

142	    own = {f: std_full[f] for f in case["negotiable"] if f in std_full}
143	    own.update({k: v for k, v in theirs.items() if v is not None})

145	    own = complete_offer(case, own)  # the terms actually sent, so the price is computed for them
146	    v0 = _value(case, std_full, {**own, "unit_price": 0.0})

152	        return (c := total_cost(case, t, std_full)) < c_alt and c < c_open

156	        for combo, c0, b in priced:

248	    def decide(self, case, threads):
249	        quoted = {s: ev for s, ev in threads.items() if _sup(ev)}
250	        if not _live(threads):  # nothing to answer: ask a thread that never wrote, else give up
251	            if (sid := self._unheard(threads)) is not None:
252	                return self._ask(case, sid)
253	            return {"supplier_id": next(iter(threads), None), "message": {"action": {"type": "walk_away"}}}
254	        if accept := closing_accept(case, quoted, by_cost=True):
255	            return accept
256	        live = [s for s in _live(threads) if moves_left(case, threads[s]) >= 1]
257	        open_ = [s for s in live if latest(threads[s]).get("status") not in ("final_offer", "agreed")]
258	
259	        def silent(s):  # no priced sheet and already asked enough: skip it, never walk away from it
260	            ev = threads[s]
261	            return not _priced(case, ev, standard_terms(ev)) and len(_mine(ev)) >= self.max_asks
262	
263	        open_ = [s for s in open_ if not silent(s)]
264	        if not open_:
265	            if (sid := self._unheard(threads)) is not None:
266	                return self._ask(case, sid)
267	            return self._close(case, quoted)
268	
269	        def key(s):  # keep every thread moving: fewest messages first, then the cheapest
270	            ev = threads[s]
271	            c = min((c for c, _ in _priced(case, ev, standard_terms(ev))), default=math.inf)
272	            return len(_mine(ev)), c
273	
274	        sid = min(open_, key=key)
275	        events = threads[sid]
276	        if moves_left(case, events) <= 1:  # our last message must never be a counter that can time out
277	            return self._close(case, quoted)
278	        std = standard_terms(events)
279	        # a must-have breach is fixed in our sheet
280	        valid = _valid(case, events, std, math.inf) or _priced(case, events, std)
281	        if not valid:  # no priced sheet to answer: ask for one
282	            return self._ask(case, sid)
283	        _, best = min(valid, key=lambda v: v[0])
284	        c_open = case_c_open(case, quoted)  # a deal at or above the opening quote scores 0
285	        sheets = self._sheets(case, events, std, best["terms"], c_open)
286	        if not sheets:  # nothing new left to offer: close on the best sheet, or give up
287	            return self._close(case, quoted)
288	        return {
289	            "supplier_id": sid,
290	            "message": {
291	                "subject": case.get("title", "Our proposal"),
292	                "body": BODY,
293	                "term_sheets": [{"terms": t} for t in sheets],
294	            },
295	        }

297	    def _sheets(self, case, events, std, theirs, c_open=math.inf):
298	        std_full = _std_full(case, events)
299	        o = _target(case, events, std_full, self.anchor)
300	        if o is None:
301	            return []
302	        a = _lowest_value(case, std_full, their_sheets(events))
303	        pins, c_alt, tick = _pins(events), _c_alt(case), _tick(a)
304	        build = _builder(case, events, std_full, theirs, pins, c_alt, c_open)
305	        seen = [s["terms"] for m in _mine(events) if m.get("term_sheets") for s in m["term_sheets"]]
306	        sheets = build(o)
307	        while sheets and sheets[0] in seen and o < a:
308	            o += tick
309	            sheets = build(o)
310	        o = min(o, a)
311	        if not sheets or sheets[0] in seen:
312	            return []
313	        return [t for i, t in enumerate(sheets) if i == 0 or t not in seen][:MAX_SHEETS]
